# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the latest published release of Filament Hugeicons,
including prereleases while the package is in alpha. Upgrade to the latest
release before checking whether an issue still occurs. Older releases do not
receive backported fixes.

This policy covers `enigmainc/filament-hugeicons`. Vulnerabilities in Laravel,
Filament, or other dependencies should also be reported through the affected
project's security policy.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/pitatumisang/filament-hugeicons/security/advisories/new)
to report suspected vulnerabilities. Private reporting is enabled for this
repository. Do not include vulnerability details in public issues or pull requests.

Include the affected package version, PHP and Filament versions, reproduction
steps or a minimal proof of concept, and the potential impact. Remove credentials
and personal data from any examples or logs.

Maintainers will assess the report and coordinate fixes and disclosure through
the private advisory. Please allow time for investigation and a fix before
publishing details. Response and resolution times depend on maintainer availability.
